plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Criminal Justice - Practicum Block (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, 'Version 2026/04/03', College of Performing Arts and Social Sciences. Header states it is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. The PDF prints both new and old course numbers (old numbers are pre-2026 renumbering, shown for reference); the new 2026-2027 numbers are used as codes. 'Social Science', 'Fine Arts and Humanities', 'Natural Science', 'Math', 'Cross-Cultural Elective', 'CRJ/Directed Elective', and 'Minor/Elective Course' name only the slot, not a course: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true. Sequenced sum 16+16+16+15+15+14+15+13 = 120, matching the printed grand TOTAL 120. 'PR = pre-requisite.'
